privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be 'Social Media Use and Psychological Well-Being Study 2024'. Required emails: smitchell@sampleuniversity.edu and irb@sampleuniversity.edu. The end URL must be https://sampleuniversity.edu/research/participation-credit. The survey must have 3 specific groups: 'Informed Consent' (1 mandatory question), 'Social Media Usage' (min 2 questions), and 'Psychological Well-Being' (min 2 questions). Settings must be: Group-by-group, Progress bar ON, Back button OFF, Anonymized responses ON. The survey must be activated.
